description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the legendary creature with flying.
When the creature dies, Jackdaw Savior triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the legendary creature with flying from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
